name: La Petite Fragrance
source:
Step into the life of Valérie, a passionate florist whose small shop is filled with stories, emotions, and secrets waiting to be unveiled. In this heartfelt journey, every flower has a meaning, and each decision opens doors to memories of the past, unexpected romances, and opportunities that could change everything.

[From [url=https://internalnovel.itch.io/la-petite-fragrance]itch.io[/url]]
